newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rate bids, offers mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rate bids, offers mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. barge rate bids and offers were mostly steady on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Friday versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 210 percent, offered 215 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 200 percent, unchanged, offered 210 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Lower Ohio River, bid 180 percent, no offer.
